messages:
Priya: Heads-up: on smaller viewports the catalog filter row becomes two lines and pushes the compare actions down. UX asked if we should group filters into categories with a compact pill or move extras to an overflow menu. quick gut reactions?

Theo: My vote is for grouped pills. e.g., 'Runtime ▾' and 'Model Size ▾' that open popovers. keeps toolbar height stable and keeps important chips visible.

Lina: Grouping looks cleaner but could hide which specific filters are active at a glance. if we group, add a compact summary like 'Runtime: dedicated, serverless'. also make sure the group popovers announce their selected items to screen readers.

Arun: From an engineering POV overflow menu is simpler: we can move low-priority chips into a menu and show a single summary chip 'More filters (4)'. But agree with Lina that summary needs to list selections on hover/focus.

Priya: Good points. Accessibility checklist suggestions:
- visible focus indicator for pills and overflow button
- `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded` on group toggles
- `aria-live` region for when filters are applied (so keyboard users get context)

Theo: Also flag: performance badges in the compare table currently use icons only (no text). we should add visually-hidden text or a tooltip describing the metric (latency, cost). some colleagues reported confusion between 'green lightning' vs 'badge'.

Lina: +1. Proposed microcopy for badges: 'Low latency (p50: 45ms)' and 'Cost-efficient (est. $0.004/req)'. make sure contrast for badge text meets 4.5:1.

Arun: On version pin behavior: when someone pins a model version inside a compare view, is that pin scoped to their session or global for the workspace? current proto makes it workspace-scoped which surprised some users. we need product decision.

Priya: Product preference is session-scoped by default (so individual users can experiment) with an explicit 'Save pin to workspace' control. UX should make scoping clear next to the pin action. e.g., small caption: 'Pinned (you)'.

Theo: UX nit: the pin control in the table is tight to the right edge and overlaps with the overflow menu on narrow widths. recommend moving pin into the row actions menu on <= 720px.

Lina: Accessibility detail for popovers: trap focus inside when open; pressing Escape should close and return focus to the trigger. for grouped pills that open small popovers consider `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal="false"` since it isn't a blocking dialog.

Arun: Dev question: storing session pins in memory vs localStorage vs server. If session-scoped, localStorage is fine but must clear when user signs out or switches workspace. server-save option for workspace pins. no privacy red flags as long as we don't store user tokens.

Priya: Next steps: Lina to produce two mocks (Group-pills variant + Overflow-menu variant) showing keyboard flow and badge tooltips. Theo to update copy for badges and pin captions. Arun will prototype storing pin state in localStorage + optional server flag. I'll schedule a quick review Thurs 11am. design-bot: mock uploads incoming. :rocket:

design-bot: Mock files uploaded: https://figma.com/file/xyz-catalog-groups-vs-overflow and https://figma.com/file/xyz-compare-badges-and-pins. accessibility report queued.
